summary: A faster web app, a lighter caution mark, and steadier tests

groups.title: Speed
items: The web app opens faster: each page loads its own code when you open it, the fonts carry only the letters Sentinel shows, and the first view draws sooner.

groups.title: Colour
items: On light pages the caution mask is yellow with a thin dark outline, lighter than warning and danger.
The caution warning card loses its solid yellow circle.

groups.title: Galaxy
items: The galaxy keeps a card held under a resting mouse.

groups.title: Wallet guard
items: Wallet guard reads the clipboard sooner, so a very fast swap is less likely to slip past.

groups.title: Live scanning
items: Live scanning marks fooled by a repaint are now checked in a real end-to-end run.

groups.title: Behind the scenes
items: Tests no longer fail at random, and test machines keep the build they test.
